title: Find the Wi-Fi device name (such as en0) on this Mac
summary: List the network hardware ports of this Mac to see which device name, such as en0 or en1, belongs to Wi-Fi. Other network commands often need this name.

aliases.text: which interface is wifi on mac

steps.explain: List every network hardware port on this Mac with its device name. Find the block whose Hardware Port is Wi-Fi; the Device line under it (for example en0) is the Wi-Fi device name. This command only reads settings.
steps.expect: Blocks such as 'Hardware Port: Wi-Fi' followed by 'Device: en0' and an 'Ethernet Address' line. Older macOS may call the port AirPort.

alternatives.explain: Show the network services in the order they are used, each with its Hardware Port and Device. The Wi-Fi entry gives the same device name.
alternatives.expect: An entry such as '(1) Wi-Fi' with a line '(Hardware Port: Wi-Fi, Device: en0)' under it.

source.title: networksetup manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
